\ Prabhat Dansena

Research Profile

   ]  Researcher in Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision with expertise in Document Intelligence
       and Image Forensics. Recipient of externally funded research projects from TIH IIT Bhilai and ICSSR.
        Published in SCI journals including IEEE Access, Scientific Reports, Multimedia Tools and Applica-
          tions, Applied Soft Computing, Signal Image and Video Processing, and IET Image Processing.
